hero.name: Wellinton Camboim
hero.tagline: 8 years in tech, focused on fintech and financial solutions, now evolving to specialize in applied AI engineering.

about.heading: About
about.body: Full-stack software engineer with 8 years in tech, working on B2B products, SaaS, and financial and payment solutions. I work from the back-end to the front-end (Node.js, Go, Java, TypeScript, React, Next.js), focused on integrations, application security, and multi-tenant architecture. I now bring that same discipline to applied AI engineering, building with Claude Code and GitHub Copilot: agents with tool calling, MCP, and prompt-injection safeguards. I hold a degree in Engineering and I'm pursuing a postgraduate degree in Applied AI Engineering, plus a postgraduate degree in Business Management (BI and E-commerce) — my education taught me to understand the business before picking the tools and the software architecture.

contact.heading: Contact
contact.intro: Email, LinkedIn, and GitHub are the best ways to reach me.
